name: M.A.H.A.K.A.L.
description: M.A.H.A.K.A.L.: Modular Agentic Hub for Automation, Knowledge & Adaptive Logic. A personal voice AI assistant built with FastAPI and React, powered by Groq (GPT-OSS 120B + Whisper) with Gemini fallback, plus Edge TTS.
highlights: Voice and text conversations with streamed responses, Whisper speech recognition, and Edge TTS playback.
Automatic Gemini fallback when the primary Groq provider fails or reaches its rate limit.
Google sign-in with guest-to-user conversation migration, persistent Firestore history, and long-term memory.
Tool calling for weather, time, Wikipedia lookup, and remembering or forgetting user preferences.
Cloud Run and Firebase Hosting deployment with Secret Manager, keyless GitHub authentication, and CI-gated releases.

case_study.problem: Personal AI assistants usually live behind closed products. I wanted a JARVIS-style assistant I fully controlled: voice-first, with persistent memory, tool calling, and a provider setup that would not fall over when a free-tier LLM hit its rate limit.
approach: FastAPI backend orchestrating LLM calls, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and tool execution behind a single streaming endpoint.
React + Vite frontend with a sci-fi HUD, live diagnostics, streaming replies, and a music player.
Firestore for conversation history and long-term memory, keyed by Google sign-in or a guest identity.
Keyless GitHub Actions pipeline deploying to Cloud Run and Firebase Hosting in a dedicated GCP project.

decisions.title: Groq primary with Gemini fallback
decisions.detail: Groq gives near-instant inference on GPT-OSS 120B and hosted Whisper, but free-tier limits are real. Every LLM call wraps the primary provider and falls back to Gemini on failure or rate limiting, so the assistant keeps answering instead of erroring.

decisions.title: Guest sessions that migrate on sign-in
decisions.detail: Letting people try the assistant before signing in improves the demo. Guests get a message budget; when they authenticate with Google, their Firestore conversation history is migrated to the permanent identity rather than discarded.

decisions.title: Firestore over a relational store
decisions.detail: Conversation and memory documents are write-simple and read-heavy with no joins, so a document database keeps the data layer at zero operational cost on the free tier.

challenges: Streaming voice replies while keeping Whisper transcription latency low required careful chunking of STT, LLM, and TTS stages.
Merging guest history into an authenticated account without duplicating or reordering messages.
Keeping a fully themed HUD responsive on mobile while the diagnostics panels animate.
case_study.outcome: A live, publicly accessible assistant at mahakal-ai.web.app that handles voice and text, remembers preferences across sessions, calls tools for weather, time and Wikipedia, and ships through a fully keyless CI/CD pipeline.

name: doppel - Mock API playground
description: doppel: your backend stand-in. A schema-driven mock REST API generator that turns a JSON schema into a working API with realistic seeded data, resource relationships, and an interactive playground. Built with FastAPI, React, and Faker.
highlights: Define resources, field types, and ref() foreign-key links in JSON, then generate reproducible data from a fixed seed.
Typed generators for uuid, person, email, date, datetime, money, enums, sentences, and more across five locales.
Dynamic REST endpoints with pagination, exact-match filtering, sorting, and per-dataset OpenAPI docs.
Interactive playground with Table and JSON views, cURL copying, starter templates, and schema import/export.
Isolated read-only public demo and per-user playgrounds on Cloud Run and Firebase Hosting, with bounded request simulation and CI-gated keyless deploys.

case_study.problem: Frontend and QA work routinely stalls waiting for a real backend. Existing fake-API tools return placeholder gibberish, lack relationships between resources, and cannot reproduce the same dataset twice.
approach: A schema language in plain JSON: resources, field types, row counts, constraints, and ref() links between resources.
A deterministic generator built on Faker so the same seed always produces the same dataset, across five locales.
Dynamic FastAPI routes per dataset with pagination, exact-match filtering, sorting, and auto-generated OpenAPI docs.
A React playground with a schema editor, Table/JSON response explorer, cURL copying, and starter templates.

decisions.title: Seeded generation over random-on-request
decisions.detail: Deterministic output means two developers, or a developer and a CI run, see identical data. The seed lives in the schema itself, so sharing a schema reproduces an exact API.

decisions.title: Isolated playgrounds, no accounts
decisions.detail: Generating an API creates an isolated per-user playground instead of requiring sign-up, keeping the demo zero-friction. A read-only public demo gives visitors instant access while bounding abuse.

decisions.title: Bounded request simulation
decisions.detail: Optional delay, HTTP error, and empty-list simulation let developers test loading and failure states against the mock before pointing the same code at production.

challenges: Resolving ref() relationships so foreign keys always point at rows that actually exist, regardless of generation order.
Validating user schemas safely in a public app without executing arbitrary input.
Keeping the workbench drafts (imports, template and locale changes) from clobbering a working API until generation succeeds.
case_study.outcome: A public tool at doppel-app.web.app that turns a JSON schema into a realistic, relational, reproducible REST API in seconds, deployed keylessly to Cloud Run and Firebase Hosting in its own GCP project.
